info.title: Z-API Omni - Z-API Compatibility
info.description: Z-API compatible API to migrate to Z-API Omni. It serves WhatsApp Official channels (`META_WHATSAPP`) only. Authentication: channel id and token in the path and the Secret Key in the `Authorization` header.

post.description: Sends a simple text message. It supports WhatsApp formatting, emojis and line breaks. `editMessageId` is refused with `422`.
Sends a message with an image. Accepts URL or Base64 (with `data:image/png;base64,` prefix).
Sends a message with a link. The Z-API fields `linkUrl` and `linkDescription` are not read: use `canonicalUrl` and `description`.
Sends a message with a `URL` button or `REPLY` buttons. `CALL`, the copy-code link and mixing `URL` with `REPLY` are refused with `422`.
Sends a message with up to 3 quick reply buttons.

value.message: How would you rate our service?
How would you rate our service?
How would you rate our service?

post.description: Sends a contact via WhatsApp. The contact does not need to be saved in your address book.
Sends a document (PDF, DOC, XLS and others). The file extension goes in the path. Accepts URL or Base64. `editDocumentMessageId` is refused with `422`.
Sends a message with a video. Accepts URL or Base64 (with `data:video/mp4;base64,` prefix).
Sends an audio message (voice message). Accepts URL or Base64 (with `data:audio/mpeg;base64,` prefix).
Sends a sticker. Accepts URL or Base64 (with `data:image/png;base64,` prefix).
Always answers `422` (`carousel is not available for this channel yet`). Nothing is sent.

example.error: carousel is not available for this channel yet

post.description: Sends an emoji reaction to a message. `messageId` and `reaction` are required.
Removes the reaction from a message. `messageId` is required.
Sends a GIF by URL or Base64. The message is delivered as an image.
Accepts the body of the Z-API PTV route. The message is delivered as a regular video, not as a round video.
Sends several contacts in one message.
Sends a location. `latitude` and `longitude` are checked before authentication.
Sends a Meta-approved template.
Generic route: the message type comes from the body fields.
Sends a verification code (OTP) message.

get.description: Tells whether the channel is connected.
Returns the channel data in the Z-API format. Fields without a value are omitted.
Returns the channel number and `isBusiness`. WhatsApp Official channels only.
Always `0`: on WhatsApp Official there is no per-channel queue.

post.description: Always an empty, last page. The body is not read.

MethodNotAllowed.description: Method not allowed. The `Allow` header lists the accepted methods.

BadRequest.description: Invalid request: missing required field, invalid media or authentication failure (`Authorization invalid`, `<ip> not allowed`).

NotFound.description: The `id` or `token` in the path does not exist.

Unprocessable.description: Send refused. The channel is not WhatsApp Official (`instance middleware is not META_WHATSAPP`), has no active subscription (`instance subscription is not active`), the route does not send or the body produces no message (`message has no content this route can send`). See Limitations and refusals.
